name: Cutscene player
author: OpenRAC
description: Plays the cutscenes made in OpenRAC Editor: camera, characters, subtitles in the disc's language, voices and music. Start skips one.

settings.name: Play cutscenes
settings.description: Off skips every cutscene as it starts; what it leaves in the world still happens. In a party the host's choice counts.

settings.name: Subtitles
settings.description: Show the cutscenes' lines at the bottom of the screen.
